verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents delivering audiences to ESPs and ad platforms. Its change data capture sends added, changed, and removed rows, which covers audience entry and exit, and syncs can run on a schedule or when data changes. The near-real-time claim, however, rests on a marketing line ('real-time or on a recurring schedule') rather than audience-specific documentation of latency. missing for 10: documented near-real-time latency for audience membership changes, audience-specific confirmation of continuous ad-platform syncing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time
